standalone_reference.scope: Unmodified production motion and mesh functions with geometry/configuration stand-ins; no compositor or GPU rendering. The same input driver runs against reference and optimized motion source.

limits: Measurements use one simulated state on a shared host without CPU affinity or frequency isolation; observations are not worst-case bounds or predictions for other machines.
Each paired run uses identical inputs and compiler settings. The second pair reverses measurement order.
Dense recovery retains 154 reachable entries;256-entry capacity cases restore discarded entries and are reported separately.
No changes to particle limits, defaults, 4ms integration slices, release envelopes or event coalescing.
GPU drawing, physical presentation, sleep/wake and outside-state allocation are not measured.
